bio: Hand-cut steak tartare with fine acidity, turbot à la meunière with a beurre blanc cooked in time-honoured tradition and ravioli stuffed with oxtail: these are the kind of classic dishes for which Erik Hendriksen is renowned. At this warm and welcoming restaurant, in an idyllic location by an old lock and close to a small harbour, familiar flavours are given the attention they deserve....
